key_insight: QUFIG uses a circuit-DAG GNN to rank gate-fault pairs by predicted impact on circuit fidelity, enabling gate-level quantum fault vulnerability detection under limited inspection budgets.
engineering_relevance: This helps quantum engineers prioritize the most security-critical gates for testing and defense, improving runtime resilience in cloud quantum workflows.
method: Builds a GNN over the quantum circuit DAG to model gate-level structure.
Predicts a vulnerability score for each gate-fault pair based on fidelity impact.
Ranks gate-fault pairs to guide inspection under restricted budgets.
evidence_signal: On QASMbench and HamLib MaxCut, QUFIG finds high-impact vulnerable gate-fault pairs with fewer inspections than random and depth-based heuristics, reducing gates requiring inspection by 2.9–19.8%.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and representativeness of training/evaluation circuits, so generalization to new hardware, noise regimes, or unseen fault types should be validated carefully.
paper_title: QUFIG: GNN-Based Prediction of Quantum Fault Injection Vulnerabilities with Gate-Level Precision
